subject: Post-call: cost & regional pricing checklist for inference
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Reiss <daniel@lighthill.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & ask: volumes, budget, residency impact

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a tailored cost estimate and proposal: 

1) Estimated monthly token consumption (inference output + input combined): you mentioned heavy batch scoring + live chat — can you confirm a range? (e.g., 5M–25M tokens/month).
2) Budget band: you flagged an initial target spend of ~$2k–$5k/month — can you confirm whether that is flexible or a hard ceiling for Q4 pilot?
3) Residency requirement: do you need EU-only data residency (customer data never leave EU) or is US-hosted acceptable for pilot?
4) SLA / dedicated capacity interest: are you expecting bursty peaks that would push you to Reserved/Dedicated vs hosted shared API?

I've attached a simple pricing worksheet (pricing_model_v2.xlsx) showing baseline per-1M token estimates and an early US vs EU cost delta to illustrate differences. For internal reference I’ve CC'd Monica to weigh in on unit economics and Marissa for any contract touchpoints.

Next steps: if you can reply with the volume bucket and residency preference, we’ll return a one-page cost proposal showing: projected monthly cost, per-1M-token target, and a recommended deployment (hosted vs Dedicated) with +/- % cost sensitivity for EU residency.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Daniel Reiss <daniel@lighthill.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lighthill Analytics <ops@lighthill.io>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 12:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: volumes, budget, residency impact

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear checklist. Answers inline: 

1) Volume: for the pilot we expect ~8M tokens/month (mostly batch scoring) with an expected ramp to ~30M/month within 6 months if latency looks good. Peak day could be ~4x average.
2) Budget: our initial procurement band for pilot is firm at $3k/month but we can consider stretch to $6k/month if justified by latency/reliability.
3) Residency: pilot can run in US first, but long-term requirement is EU data residency for the product serving EU customers (deadline ~Q1 next year). So we need visibility into EU premium and what changes to architecture would be required.
4) SLA / dedicated: likely want to start hosted, evaluate Dedicated once steady at 20M+ tokens.

Also attached is our SOC2 and compliance contact; happy to share more artifacts if that helps.

Would like a one-pager that shows: cost @ $/1M for US and EU, an estimate of what Dedicated would cost vs hosted, and a call to review the worksheet early next week (Mon/Tue preferred).

Best,
Daniel
Daniel Reiss
Head of Engineering | Lighthill Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Reiss <daniel@lighthill.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: volumes, budget, residency impact

Hi Daniel — looping in a quick cost/units perspective so you have something concrete for procurement. Below are Redwood’s typical starting points (pilot / hosted), with a rough band we use internally when qualifying: 

- Baseline (US hosted, shared capacity): ~USD 300 per 1M tokens (input+output combined) for batch-heavy workloads at pilot scale.
- EU hosted premium: +15%–25% depending on region and whether KMS/HSM replication + data residency controls are required. For planning use +20% as a midpoint (so EU ~USD 360 per 1M tokens).
- Dedicated / Reserved capacity: unit cost can drop ~20%–35% at steady high volume (20M+ tokens/month) but requires a commit and a throughput sizing conversation.
- Additional residency/DPA/contracting overhead: one-time setup or legal billing estimates, typically modest but sometimes APAC/EU contracts add professional services for network setup.

Given your numbers: pilot = 8M tokens/month at baseline US rate (USD 300/1M) => ~USD 2,400/month. If you hit the stretch budget of $6k/month you’re effectively targeting ~20M tokens/month at US rates. If the pilot needs to be EU-only from day one, plan for ~USD 2,880/month (8M * 360/1M).

Suggested ask for the one-pager from our side:
- Provide a 2-line cost table: US hosted / EU hosted / Dedicated (20M commit estimate) with monthly numbers for 8M and 20M.
- Call out expected delta drivers (eg. KMS replication, egress, dedicated infra).
- Recommend next steps: pilot in US (fastest on-ramp) + timeline to add EU residency when you reach threshold.

I’ve updated the attached pricing_model_v2.xlsx with the numbers above. If that looks reasonable we can produce the one-pager and a calendar invite for Mon/Tue review.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Reiss <daniel@lighthill.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 01:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: volumes, budget, residency impact

Thanks Monica — the numbers are helpful and match what procurement wanted to see. Quick confirmations: 

- Pilot: US hosted OK (we’ll do EU residency for GA).
- Pilot target: 8M tokens/month, budget firm at $3k/mo. If costs are lower we can scale usage but need to assume $3k cap for procurement approval.
- Please send the 1-page cost table and calendar invite for Tue (I’m available 10:00–12:00 CET).

Also: we’ll upload the SOC2 snapshot to the link you shared; attaching our internal compliance contact for contracting: hannah.compliance@lighthill.io

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Daniel
